title: UI accessibility enhancements
author: audioses
lessons: Accessibility PRs need narrow scope -- 15 files with 5+ patterns is too broad for one review
Don't duplicate native HTML APIs -- ariaLabel prop is redundant when aria-label works via ...props spread
Web components have shadow DOM boundaries -- slotted visually-hidden text may not associate as labels
Overlapping approaches (explicit props + auto-injection) multiply review surface -- pick one
Stale PRs accumulate merge debt -- 3+ weeks old with conflicts
blockers: Merge conflicts (CONFLICTING status) -- ghost vs autocomplete tab label
